security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

bundle.shortDescription: A local knowledge graph for a codebase.
bundle.longDescription: Athenaeum keeps a persistent, navigable network of project knowledge — decisions, gotchas, symbols, evidence — so a coding agent stops rediscovering the same things every session.
